title: My Pages
description: Manage and connect your Facebook & Instagram pages
descriptionChannels: Your connected pages and WhatsApp numbers
noPagesDesc: Connect your first page to begin receiving comments.
igOnlyPrompt: Is your business on Instagram only, without a Facebook Page?
igOnlyCta: I want to connect Instagram directly
igOnlyThanks: Thank you — we have recorded your interest in direct Instagram connection.
noPagesDescChannels: Connect your first channel — a Facebook Page or a WhatsApp number — to start replying.
businessInfoDesc: Add info about your products and services to improve replies
businessInfoPlaceholder: Example: We are a clothing store in Riyadh. We sell men's and women's clothing. Prices start from 100 SAR. We deliver to all areas.
instagramLinkHint: Link an Instagram Business Account to your Facebook Page to enable auto-replies
pageLimitReached: Page limit reached. Disable another page or upgrade your plan.
pageLimitReachedIOS: Page limit reached. Disable another page to enable this one.
subscriptionInactive: Your subscription isn't active. Please renew it to continue.
instagramTooltip: Make sure your Instagram Business account is connected to this Page in Meta settings, then click Sync.
whatsappReconnectDescription: Your WhatsApp connection has expired, so replies have stopped. Reconnect to start answering again — it takes a minute and your Business Info is kept.
whatsappTooltip: Jawab will answer your WhatsApp messages using this page's Business Info. You choose whether to keep the number on your phone or dedicate it to Jawab24. Need different info for this number? Add it as its own WhatsApp card instead.
whatsappPathSubtitle: One question, so we connect the number the right way.
whatsappPathKeep: I already use this number on WhatsApp Business
whatsappPathKeepDesc: Keep it on your phone. Jawab replies alongside you, and your chats and contacts stay where they are.
whatsappPathDedicated: This number is only for Jawab24
whatsappPathDedicatedDesc: A spare number Jawab answers on its own. It will stop working in the WhatsApp app.
whatsappConnectFailed: Could not connect WhatsApp. Please try again.
whatsappNumberTaken: This WhatsApp number is already connected to another page.
whatsappPopupBlocked: The WhatsApp signup window could not open. Please click Connect again, and allow pop-ups for this site if your browser blocked it.
whatsappNoNumberSelected: No phone number was added to your WhatsApp Business account. Complete the signup and choose a number, then try again.
whatsappPinMismatch: This number has two-step verification enabled in the WhatsApp Business app. Turn it off there, then try connecting again.
whatsappCoexistenceHint: Also on your phone — turn off the app's greeting and away messages
whatsappCoexistenceInfo: Jawab24 answers on this number alongside your WhatsApp Business app. Turn off the app's Greeting Message and Away Message so customers don't get two replies. When you reply to a customer from your phone, Jawab24 pauses on that conversation for {minutes} minutes, then resumes.
whatsappPlanRequired: WhatsApp smart replies are available on the Business plan and higher. Upgrade to connect your number.
whatsappPlanRequiredIOS: WhatsApp smart replies are not available on your current plan.
whatsappAmbiguousNumber: We couldn't tell which number you just connected. Please try again and add a single number in Meta's window.
whatsappDesktopNeededBody: Meta's WhatsApp connection window is built for desktop browsers and often fails to open on phones. For a reliable connection, open jawab24.com on a computer and connect from there. You can still try on this device.
whatsappDisconnectMessage: Jawab will stop replying on {number}. Your conversation history stays, and you can reconnect the number anytime.
channelPickerTitle: Which channel do you want to connect?
channelFacebookDesc: Connect your Facebook Page — Messenger messages, comments, and the Instagram account linked to the Page. WhatsApp can be added later.
channelInstagramDesc: Connect your professional Instagram account directly — messages and comments, no Facebook Page needed.
instagramConnectFailed: Could not connect the Instagram account. Please try again.
instagramAccountTaken: This Instagram account is already connected to another workspace.
instagramAlreadyLinked: This Instagram account is already connected through its Facebook Page.
instagramWebhooksFailed: Instagram is connected, but we could not turn on message delivery. Please reconnect the account.
instagramReconnectDescription: Your Instagram connection is no longer valid, so replies have stopped. Reconnect to start answering again — it takes a minute and your Business Info is kept.
instagramOnlyRemoveMessage: Jawab will stop replying on {account} and this card will be removed. Conversation history is kept, and you can connect the account again anytime.
channelWhatsAppDesc: Connect just your WhatsApp Business number — it keeps working on your phone as usual, and a quick Facebook sign-in verifies it.
whatsappOnlyRemoveMessage: Jawab will stop replying on {number} and this card will be removed. Conversation history is kept, and you can connect the number again anytime.
archiveAction: Hide this page from the list
archiveMessage: {name} will no longer appear in your channels. All of its data — conversations, settings, and business info — is kept, and reconnecting the page through Facebook brings it back exactly as it was.
archiveSuccess: Page hidden. Reconnect it through Facebook anytime to bring it back.
businessInfoModalDesc: Add information about your business here to answer customer questions accurately.
businessInfoExample:
We sell handmade leather bags.

Products:
- Red Classic Bag: $49
- Blue Premium Bag: $59
- Mini Wallet: $19

Shipping: Free for orders over $100
Delivery: 3-5 business days
Returns: 14 days, no questions asked
saveFailed: Failed to save. Please try again.
saveFailedAccessRevoked: Your access to this workspace was revoked. Please contact the workspace owner.
saveFailedInsufficientRole: Only an owner or admin can change Business Info. Ask a workspace admin to update it.
connectDialogBody: You'll be redirected to Facebook. To add or change pages, click "Edit previous settings" on the Facebook screen.
noPagesPermissionsDeclined: You didn't grant Jawab24 permission to see your Pages. Tap Connect and enable the Pages permission in the Facebook window.
noPagesUnreachable: You granted access to a Page, but we couldn't reach it. Tap Connect and re-select your Page in the Facebook window.
noPagesInstagramOnly: It looks like your business is on Instagram. Link Instagram directly using the option below, or link your Instagram professional account to a Facebook Page and reconnect.
noPagesNoAdminAccount: Your Facebook account doesn't manage any Page. If your business has a Page, sign in with the Facebook account that administers it — or create a new Page and reconnect.
sessionExpired: Session expired. Please reconnect with Facebook.
connectedAgo: Connected {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} ago
storeConnectedBadge: Smart replies powered by your {platform} store
reconnectDescription: Facebook revoked access to this page, so Facebook and Instagram replies are paused. Your other channels keep working.
demoConnectRedirect: To connect your Facebook pages, sign in with your Facebook account.
reconnectDialogBody: You'll be redirected to Facebook to re-authorize access to this page. To change pages, click "Edit previous settings" on the Facebook screen. After granting permissions, auto-replies will resume automatically.
businessInfoNudgeText: Add your Business Info so replies get more accurate
businessInfoNudgeTextStrong: Jawab can only greet until you add your Business Info — it needs it to actually answer your customers.
enableWithoutInfoTitle: Turn on auto-reply without Business Info?
enableWithoutInfoMessage: Jawab will only greet customers and hand off — it can't answer questions until you add your Business Info.
businessInfoRequiredToEnable: Add your Business Info first — Jawab has nothing to answer your customers from.
whatsappConnectedAddBusinessInfo: Number connected. Add your Business Info to switch Smart Replies on.
pageTakenWarning: {count, plural, one {‹{pageNames}› is connected to another Jawab24 account, so it wasn't connected here.} other {These pages are connected to another Jawab24 account, so they weren't connected here: {pageNames}.}} To fix it: disconnect in the other account and try again, or contact support to move {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} to your account.
pageTakenInWorkspace: {count, plural, one {# page is} other {# pages are}} already in workspace ‹{workspaceName}› where you're already a member. Switch to that workspace to manage them.
pageTrialUsedWarning: {count, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} connected, but auto-reply stays off because the free trial has already been used on {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}. Subscribe to enable auto-reply.
pageTrialUsedBlocked: This page has already used its free trial. Subscribe to enable auto-reply.
pageLimitSkippedWarning: {count, plural, one {{pageNames} was not connected} other {{count} pages were not connected ({pageNames})}} because your plan includes {limit, plural, one {one page} other {# pages}}. Upgrade to connect more pages.
trialUsedSkippedWarning: {count, plural, one {{pageNames} was not connected} other {{count} pages were not connected ({pageNames})}} because this account's free trial has already been used. Subscribe to connect and enable auto-reply.
loadFailed: Failed to load your pages. Please try again.
autoPausedSendRejected: Facebook kept rejecting our replies on this page, so auto-reply was paused to protect your quota. Check the page on Facebook — it may be restricted, unpublished, or missing a permission — then turn auto-reply back on.
